$comment: Files exempt from scripts/hex-gate.mjs. Globs relative to the repo root (forward slashes). Every entry needs a reason.

reasons.apps/mixai/src/packs/builtin-skins.ts: skin pack DATA (same role as .mixaipack tokens.json): user-selectable palettes incl. Okabe-Ito colour-blind set and a pure black/white high-contrast skin; contrast-gated by apply-tokens.test.ts
reasons.apps/mixai/src/packs/apply-tokens.test.t: tests the pack colour parser and WCAG contrast maths on hex inputs
reasons.apps/tv-android/.../Tokens.kt: generated by packages/design-tokens (Color(0x…) is the only Compose form)
reasons.apps/tv-tizen/src/styles.css: `@supports not (color: oklch(0 0 0))` sRGB fallback block for Tizen Chromium < 111, mirrored from Tokens.kt
reasons.apps/tv-tizen/src/screens/SignIn.tsx: QR canvas must be pure #000000/#ffffff for scanner contrast
reasons.apps/tv-tizen/src/screens/Pair.tsx: QR canvas must be pure #000000/#ffffff for scanner contrast
reasons.server/ui/src/views/AuthView.tsx: Google 'G' brand mark — colours fixed by Google's brand guidelines
reasons.apps/web/src/app/theme-color-meta.tsx: <meta name=theme-color> cannot read CSS variables — sRGB of the --background tokens
reasons.**/visualizer*/palettes.ts: audio visualizer palettes are artistic data, not UI chrome
